        theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_two_projectiveClasses_spanning (R : Type u) [Ring R] [Module.Finite ℝ (RealProjectiveSpace R)] (h : Module.finrank ℝ (RealProjectiveSpace R) ≤ 2) :
        ∃ (P : FiniteProjective R) (Q : FiniteProjective R), ∀ (v : RealProjectiveSpace R), ∃ (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ), a • (realProjectiveClass R) (ProjectiveClass.of P) + b • (realProjectiveClass R) (ProjectiveClass.of Q) = v

        If the real space has dimension at most two, it is spanned by the classes of two finite projectives. A zero projective may fill an unused slot.

        theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_presilting_cover_of_projective_rank_le_two (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite ℝ (RealProjectiveSpace R)] (hrank : Module.finrank ℝ (RealProjectiveSpace R) ≤ 2) (hR : IsEFinite R) :
        ∃ (s : List (TwoTerm R × TwoTerm R)), (∀ p ∈ s, (p.1.directSum p.2).IsPresilting) ∧ ∀ (v : RealProjectiveSpace R), ∃ p ∈ s, v ∈ sectorBetween ((realProjectiveClass R) p.1.projectiveClass) ((realProjectiveClass R) p.2.projectiveClass)

        E-finiteness in real projective rank at most two gives a finite cover by sectors of presilting pairs.
